name: ceresasm
description: Language support for CASM, the assembler of the Ceres virtual machine: syntax highlighting, live diagnostics from the real ceres compiler, and a debugger.

commands.title: CeresASM: Send Input to the Running Program

ceresAsm.compilerPath.description: Path to the ceres executable used to check .casm files. Leave empty to auto-detect the most recently built one under Ceres/build/<preset>/bin/<config>/ or fall back to PATH.

ceresAsm.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inlay hints in .casm files. Turning this off hides all of them, whatever the individual settings below say.

ceresAsm.inlayHints.variableTypes.markdownDescription: After a global variable, the type it was declared with — the one a `ldv`/`stv` picks its width from.

ceresAsm.inlayHints.constantValues.markdownDescription: After a `const`, the value substituted where it is written; after a `struct` name, its size in bytes.

ceresAsm.inlayHints.structOffsets.markdownDescription: After `Frame.field`, the byte offset that name stands for — the number that ends up in the displacement.

ceresAsm.inlayHints.macroParameterNames.markdownDescription: Before each argument of a macro call, the name the macro gave that parameter.

ceresAsm.inlayHints.portNames.markdownDescription: After the port number of an `in`/`out`, the name it has in the default port map, and whether anything is behind it.

ceresAsm.inlayHints.registerAliases.markdownDescription: After a name declared with `alias`, the register it stands for.

ceresAsm.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VSCode and the CeresASM language server.

program.description: The .casm source or .cres binary to debug.

sources.description: Additional .casm files to link into the same program, as 'ceres asm' would.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop before the first instruction instead of running to the first breakpoint.

memory.description: Machine memory in bytes. Defaults to the VM's own 16 MiB.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debugger process. Defaults to the program's own folder.

ceresPath.description: Path to the ceres executable. Empty uses 'ceresAsm.compilerPath', then autodetection.

trace.description: Print the debugger command line to the Debug Console.

configurationSnippets.label: CeresASM: Debug the current file
configurationSnippets.description: Assemble and debug the .casm file that is open in the editor.

configurationSnippets.label: CeresASM: Debug a built .cres
configurationSnippets.description: Debug an already-assembled program. Assemble it with --debug for source lines.
